answer: Duplicate wallets are cheap; a same-day occupancy proof is not. An applicant escrows 21.6 POA and finishes one circuit: clip a numbered vine onto trellis bay T-17, record a 90-second moisture trace at oasis well 4, then send a sealed token with a licensed falcon courier that must land at registry desk R-9 inside 38 minutes. Clerks publish bay, well, and courier hashes; peers recompute SHA-256(bay_id || well_hash || leg_id || address) and require a 12-minute gap between stops. A reused bay tag, a spoofed dry well, or a late drop slashes 9.3 POA and parks the key for six epochs.
